title: Deep Adaptive Bayesian Screening
abstract: arXiv:2607.16927v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Deep Adaptive Bayesian Screening (DABS), a method for performing adaptive factorial screening in discrete design spaces under tight experimental budgets. DABS learns a policy network offline to sequentially select informative experiments, amortizing Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design. It handles binary designs, incorporates sparsity and interactions via a spike-and-slab prior with strong heredity. The model is trained using a contrastive lower bound on information about factor activity with nuisance effect sizes and noise variance analytically integrated out. translated_title: 深度自适应贝叶斯筛选
translated_abstract: 我们提出了深度自适应贝叶斯筛选，这是一种在严格的实验预算下，于离散设计空间中执行自适应因子筛选的方法。DABS离线学习一个策略网络来顺序选择信息量大的实验，从而摊销贝叶斯最优实验设计。它能够处理二元设计，并通过带有强遗传性的尖峰-平板先验引入稀疏性和交互作用。该模型使用关于因子活性的信息对比下界进行训练，其中干扰效应大小和噪声方差被解析地积分掉。与先前的摊销贝叶斯设计方法不同，DABS还在部署阶段集成了后验推断，产生因子活性的后验概率以及效应大小的可信区间。我们在根据已发表的实验基准校准的模拟筛选问题上评估了DABS，结果表明其性能与最强的非自适应方法相当或更优。
tldr: DABS通过离线学习策略网络在严格实验预算下自适应地执行因子筛选，并创新性地在部署时整合后验推断，从而同时给出因子活性概率和效应大小的可信区间。
en_tdlr: DABS learns a policy network offline to adaptively perform factorial screening under tight experimental budgets, and uniquely integrates posterior inference at deployment to yield factor activity probabilities and credible intervals on effect sizes.
